verdict.rationale: Cline documents Bring Your Own Key, which lets users supply their own cloud provider credentials. This loosely touches authenticating through a cloud platform, but nothing describes enterprise identity (SSO/SAML/OIDC) or cloud-platform IAM integration aimed at compliance and scale. missing for 10: enterprise SSO/identity-provider sign-in, explicit cloud-platform auth (e.g., IAM-based Bedrock/Vertex/Azure access), compliance and admin controls documentation, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability

citations.quote: Bring Your Own Key (BYOK): use your own provider credentials (cloud or local runtimes).
